verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents true bulk transfer-in (up to 500 domains per submission) and setting auto-renewal across a portfolio. It also has a REST API and MCP server for registering, renewing and transferring domains, so a power user can script other bulk work. Moving domains to Cloudflare, which repoints nameservers, is also described for multiple domains. missing for 10: explicit bulk availability search, bulk registration in one operation, bulk manual renewal, bulk nameserver changes to arbitrary nameservers, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
